actual_payload.description: One compact chunky dungeon gate and surrounding stone arch for Dungeon Matcher, an orthographic FRONT-FACING side-scroller battle background prop. No perspective, no tunnel, no ground plane. On a transparent 96x112 native pixel canvas, complete centered architecture approximately 84 pixels wide and 96 pixels tall with generous clear padding. Semicircular castle arch made of large simple violet-purple voussoir stone wedges, one subtly emphasized top keystone; stout straight stone piers down to one level baseline. Dark closed barred dungeon gate seated inside the arch: five or six straight vertical indigo iron bars, one restrained horizontal brace across the middle, quiet deep shadow behind them, only two tiny dull bronze hinge or ring accents. No spikes, skull carvings, filigree, chains, torches, banners or characters. Broad clean connected matte stone planes with restrained top-left bevel lighting; stone base #413451 with #302940 shaded planes, #67537D limited bevels, rare #846A95 light. Gate is darker blue-indigo #10131F/#181C2D/#28283F with #35324F tiny left edges, bronze #5B3627/#8A5622/#B07A43. Strong silhouette, one-source-pixel hard contours, very low detail, simple intact blocks, no scattered chips or texture, no glow, blur, gradients, dithering or anti-aliasing. Reference sprite supplies pixel scale, economical shading clusters, and outline discipline ONLY, not skeleton anatomy, crown, face, gold/red/cyan palette or stance. This is an architectural asset, not a full scene or interface.
